ctx.self: You may feel driven, hungry or intensely focused on worldly goals. There is nothing wrong with that energy. Just check that your ambition reflects your true Will, not other people's expectations or old fears. Pan laughs; you can too.
ctx.others: Others may see you as powerful, magnetic or a little intimidating. Alternatively, someone around you is charismatic and persuasive; enjoy their energy, but keep your own judgement and do not hand over your power. Charm is not the same as trust.
ctx.hopes: You may hope for success, pleasure and freedom from scarcity, while fearing being trapped by your own desires or by someone else's control. Both point to the same question: who is holding the reins? Mostly, the answer is you.
ctx.love: In love, the Devil brings strong attraction, passion and chemistry. It can also point to jealousy, dependency or power games. Enjoy the heat, but keep the relationship honest and freely chosen on both sides. Desire thrives where there is also respect.
ctx.work: At work, ambition and staying power are your allies. This is a time to build steadily, negotiate firmly and think long-term about money. Beware of golden handcuffs, overwork or deals that cost more than they pay.
ctx.spirit: Spirit reminds you that matter is sacred too. Your body, your senses and your worldly creativity are not obstacles to the divine but expressions of it. Laugh, create, and find the holy in the earthy.
ctx.release: Release shame about your desires, and release the habits that keep you small. Let go of a fear of scarcity that makes you cling, or a pattern that has become a cage. You can keep the passion without the chain.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be an addiction, a fear or an attachment you rationalise. Or there is a part of your wild nature that you have repressed so firmly that it now leaks out sideways. Bring it into the open and it becomes power.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a powerful drive, perhaps for security, recognition or pleasure. Understanding what you truly hunger for, and why, reveals what really steers the whole situation. The goat climbs because he wants to; know what your own summit is, and whether it is truly yours to climb.
ctx.gift: Your gift is vitality, the ability to work hard, persist and enjoy the fruits of your labour. Your earthy creative power can build almost anything. Used wisely, it is a blessing, not a burden. Pan's laughter keeps it light.

name: XVI · The Tower
title: The Tower
imagery: A rigid tower is shattered by flames from a great open Eye above, and stiff, geometric figures tumble from its broken walls. At its base the jaws of a fiery mouth spit flames, while a dove carrying an olive branch and a lion-headed serpent hover at the top. The Eye of Horus destroys only what is false and fixed, and the dove and serpent promise peace and a new, more alive desire on the other side.
meaning: Ruled by Mars, the Thoth Tower is the lightning flash that breaks open structures that have become prisons. It can feel shocking, but what falls is what was already hollow: illusions, rigid habits, false security. Crowley linked it to the destruction of the old and the awakening of the eye that sees truth. This card asks you to let the walls come down rather than spending your energy shoring them up. On the other side lies freedom, a cleared field where something more authentic can be built.
numerology: Sixteen reduces to seven, the number of trial and inner victory; its four times four is the fixed structure pushed past its limits until it breaks open.
affirmation: I let false structures fall and welcome the freedom of truth.

ctx.past: A sudden upheaval in your past broke something open, perhaps a belief, a home or a plan that crumbled overnight. Shocking as it was, it cleared away what was false. The freedom and honesty you have now grew from that fall.
ctx.present: Something is breaking open right now. The heart of the matter is a revelation or disruption that shakes up a fixed situation. Resist the urge to hold the walls together; the truth that is emerging is more solid than what is falling away.
ctx.future: A sudden change or revelation is coming. It may arrive as a surprise, an insight or a shake-up you did not plan for. Afterward, you will find you are freer and more honest with yourself, and ready to build on firmer ground.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is rigidity, the effort to protect a structure that is no longer sound. Or it is anger and destructiveness, tearing things down without care. Ask what needs dismantling and what needs protecting, and act with clear eyes.
ctx.advice: Face the truth, even if it shakes things up. Speak the thing that needs saying, end the pretence, or take down the wall that keeps life out. Then let the dust settle before you rebuild.
ctx.self: You may feel shaken, restless or full of a fiery urge to break free. Something in you will no longer tolerate what is false. That inner lightning is an ally; direct it toward liberation, not self-punishment.
ctx.others: Others may be surprised by changes in you, or by a revelation you bring to light. Or someone in your environment is the catalyst who breaks open a stuck situation. It may be uncomfortable, but it ultimately helps.
ctx.hopes: You may hope for a breakthrough that finally sets you free, and fear the chaos that change will bring. The Tower brings both, but the chaos is temporary and the freedom tends to last. Every fall clears space.
ctx.love: In love, the Tower can bring a revelation, an argument that clears the air, or a sudden shift. Illusions fall away. Couples who are willing to rebuild on honesty can come through stronger; what was built on pretence may not stand.
ctx.work: At work, expect restructuring, a sudden change of plans, or a moment when an unsustainable situation comes to a head. Stay flexible, avoid risky bets, and look for the opportunity hidden in the shake-up. Clear ground makes better foundations.
ctx.spirit: Spirit opens its eye and shows you what is real. The lightning is grace in disguise, breaking you out of a too-small life. Trust that you are being freed, not punished. The dove with the olive branch already circles above the ruins, carrying the promise of peace.
ctx.release: Release the need for control and the illusion of permanent security. Let go of a structure, belief or role you have outgrown, even if it once kept you safe. What is true will remain. Rubble can be swept away.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be suppressed anger, or a truth you have been refusing to look at. When it is held down too long, it erupts. Letting it out deliberately and safely prevents the explosion. Fire contained warms a home.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies something built on shaky ground, a false assumption, an old compromise, or a structure that never fit you. Acknowledging the crack is the first step to building something sound. Better to see it now than later.
ctx.gift: Your gift is courage in the face of upheaval and the clarity that comes when illusions fall. You can rebuild from nothing, and you see more clearly than ever. That honesty is powerful medicine. Few people stand so firmly in reality.

name: XVII · The Star
title: The Star
imagery: The sky goddess Nuit kneels in a starry landscape, pouring luminous waters from a golden cup and a silver cup, one over her head and one onto the earth below. A great seven-pointed star shines above her, and spirals of light curl through the scene around a globe and crystals and roses. The waters flow both to heaven and earth, showing a stream of inspiration that renews everything it touches.
meaning: The Thoth Star is Nuit herself, the infinite night sky in which every person is a star with their own path. After the upheaval of the Tower, this card brings calm, renewal and a quiet, radiant hope. It invites you to open to inspiration, to trust your own orbit, and to let your gifts flow freely, both to yourself and to the world. Crowley linked it to Aquarius, the water-bearer of the new age, pouring vision out for all. Breathe, look up, and remember that you are guided by a light that is truly your own.
numerology: Seventeen reduces to eight, renewal and flowing order; as seven plus ten, it is spiritual inspiration completing a cycle and pouring out into the world.
affirmation: I am a star, and I trust the light that guides me.

ctx.past: After a difficult season in your past, a quiet sense of hope returned. Perhaps someone inspired you, or a vision showed you a new direction. That renewal is still a source of strength, reminding you that you can always find your way back to the light.
ctx.present: You are in a time of healing and renewal. The heart of the matter is hope, and the inspiration that is flowing to you right now. Let it in, trust it, and allow yourself to be nourished after a long or hard stretch.
ctx.future: Brighter days and fresh inspiration are coming. Expect clarity about your path, renewed faith in yourself, and a calmer, more open heart. Goals that felt distant begin to feel reachable. Like Nuit's waters, good things will flow to you and through you, renewing the places that felt dry.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is to stay grounded while dreaming. You may be idealistic to the point of passivity, waiting for a sign rather than acting. Or discouragement has dimmed your light. Let the waters flow both upward and down, into practical life.
ctx.advice: Look up and follow your own star. Make time for what inspires you: art, nature, quiet nights, spiritual practice. Then share your gifts generously. Small, hopeful actions now align you with a bigger purpose. Your light is meant to be shared.
ctx.self: You are rediscovering your inner light and your sense of what is possible. You may feel more open, peaceful and hopeful than in a long while. Trust that you are on your own unique path.
ctx.others: Others may see you as an inspiration or a calm, healing presence. Or someone in your environment, a mentor, friend or artist, brings hope and vision that helps you see your way forward. Their faith in you may help you rediscover your own.
ctx.hopes: You hope for healing, meaning and a future that feels genuinely yours. You may fear that hope will be disappointed again. The Star says hope is not naïve here; it is guidance. Let it lead you forward, one bright step at a time.
ctx.love: In love, the Star brings tenderness, honesty and renewed trust. Existing bonds can heal and deepen, and new connections may feel spiritually aligned. Open your heart gently and let affection flow freely. Tenderness and truthfulness are the twin cups you pour from here.
ctx.work: At work, inspiration and vision are your strengths. Creative projects, humanitarian work and long-range goals are favoured. Keep faith in your ideas and take steady, practical steps toward them. A long-held dream may finally find a practical form, especially if it serves more than just you.
ctx.spirit: Spirit reminds you that every man and every woman is a star. You are part of the infinite, held in its embrace. Your path is unique, and the universe supports you when you follow your true Will.
ctx.release: Release cynicism and old disappointments that keep you from hoping. Let go of comparisons with other people's paths; your orbit is your own. Let the past wash away in the waters. Like Nuit, pour the old water out so fresh water can flow in.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a dream you have stopped believing in, or a fear that you are not worthy of your own light. Bring that dream gently back into view and give it a little care.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a vision or deep longing that has guided you all along, even when you forgot it. Reconnecting with that core inspiration reorients everything. Like the seven-pointed star above Nuit, it has been quietly shining the whole time, waiting for you to look up.
ctx.gift: Your gift is radiant hope and the ability to inspire. You can renew others simply by shining. That openness and faith are rare treasures in any situation. Like water poured on parched earth, your presence revives what seemed lost, and reminds people that the night sky is full of stars.

name: XVIII · The Moon
title: The Moon
imagery: Two jackal-headed guardians stand beside twin dark towers beneath a waning moon, with jackals at their feet and a path of shadow running between them. Below, in murky waters, a sacred scarab beetle pushes the sun upward through the night. The scene is the gate of the dark night, a place of dreams and fears where the light is being carried toward dawn even when you cannot see it.
meaning: The Thoth Moon is the threshold of night, where everything is half-seen and nothing is quite what it appears. Ruled by Pisces, it speaks of dreams, intuition, and the deep, sometimes frightening currents of the unconscious. This card warns against fixed conclusions while the light is dim, and asks you to walk the path carefully, guided by instinct rather than panic. Yet the scarab is already rolling the sun upward: this darkness is the passage to rebirth. Trust your inner sight, face your fears honestly, and keep walking toward the dawn.
numerology: Eighteen reduces to nine, the number of the hermit's solitary journey; as twice nine, it doubles the long passage through darkness that comes before a new beginning.
affirmation: I trust my inner sight to guide me through the dark.

ctx.past: A time of confusion or uncertainty in your past left impressions that still linger. Perhaps you misjudged something, or lived through a fog of fear or illusion. You came through it, and it deepened your intuition, even if parts still feel unresolved.
ctx.present: You are walking through the half-light, and things are not entirely clear. The heart of the matter lies in the unconscious: dreams, fears, intuitions and hidden factors. Go slowly, and do not mistake shadows for facts.
ctx.future: A period of uncertainty or deep dreaming is coming, a passage where you cannot see far ahead. It is a threshold, not a dead end. Your intuition will grow sharper, and the dawn will follow.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is illusion, anxiety or deception, including self-deception. Fear may be painting monsters in the shadows, or someone may not be telling the whole truth. Check facts, trust your gut, and refuse to act from panic.
ctx.advice: Trust your intuition and pay attention to your dreams. Gather more information before you decide anything major. Move carefully, step by step, and remember the scarab: the light is on its way. Your dreams may hold clues; keep a notebook by the bed.
ctx.self: You may feel unsettled, sensitive or unsure of your footing. That is because you are close to deep material in yourself. Be gentle, rest more, and let your inner wisdom speak in its own time.
ctx.others: Others may find you mysterious or hard to read right now. Or someone in your environment is not quite what they seem. Do not jump to conclusions, but stay alert and keep your boundaries clear.
ctx.hopes: You may hope for clarity and fear the unknown. The dark is uncomfortable, but it is also where dreams and creativity are born. Your fear is valid; it is not the full story. Many beautiful things grow in moonlight.
ctx.love: In love, the Moon can bring confusion, projection or secrets. Ask for honesty, and watch for idealising or fearing your partner without evidence. Deep emotional and psychic connection is also possible when both are willing to be real.
ctx.work: At work, information may be incomplete or plans unclear. Read the fine print, avoid hasty financial moves, and trust your instincts about people. Creative, intuitive and healing work can thrive under this card. Wait for clearer light before signing anything binding.
ctx.spirit: Spirit leads you through the dark night of the soul. This is a sacred passage, guided by ancient guardians. Your intuition, dreams and symbols are messages; listen closely, for the sun is rising within you.
ctx.release: Release fears that are not grounded in reality, and the illusions you have been clinging to. Let go of trying to see the whole road at once. You only need enough light for the next step.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here are fears, memories or longings that live just below awareness. They may be steering your reactions. Gently bringing them into the light, through journaling or dreamwork, can transform them. What you face in the dark loses its teeth.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies something unconscious: an old fear, a family pattern, or a dream that never found expression. Understanding it brings clarity to the whole situation. Like the scarab under the water, something important is already moving toward the light, even if it works unseen.
ctx.gift: Your gift is deep intuition and a rich imaginative life. You can sense what others miss and navigate the darkness by inner sight. That sensitivity is a strength, not a weakness. Like the jackal guardians, you can walk the night paths without losing your way, and help others find theirs.

name: XIX · The Sun
title: The Sun
imagery: A radiant sun blazes over a green mound, its rays spreading across a ring of the zodiac, while two winged children dance joyfully on the hill below. A wall encircles the mount, but the children are free and playful within and beyond it, and a rose cross glows at the sun's heart. It is the Lord of the New Aeon in his brightest form: light, life, love and liberty for everyone.
meaning: The Thoth Sun is the joy and freedom of a new dawn, the light of consciousness shining fully after the night of the Moon. It brings vitality, success, clarity and the pure delight of being alive. Crowley saw it as the spirit of the new age, in which humanity can be as free and spontaneous as children at play. This card encourages you to shine without apology, to celebrate, and to let your natural warmth and creativity radiate. Whatever the question, the outlook brightens.
numerology: Nineteen reduces to one, the new beginning; as nine plus ten, it completes the full cycle and opens a bright new one.
affirmation: I shine freely, and my joy lights the way for others.

ctx.past: A happy, sunlit time in your past laid strong foundations. Perhaps a success, a joyful relationship or a carefree period showed you what thriving feels like. That warmth still nourishes you and reminds you what is possible.
ctx.present: Light is shining on your situation. The heart of the matter is joy, clarity and vitality. Things are going well or are about to, so enjoy it, celebrate it, and let yourself be seen. This is a season for openness and play.
ctx.future: Success, happiness and clarity are coming. Expect a sunny turn of events, recognition, or a renewed zest for life. What was confusing will become clear, and you will feel free to be yourself. The walls around you will feel more like a garden than a prison.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is too much sun: overconfidence, burnout, or a forced cheerfulness that hides real feelings. Or you may be holding yourself back from shining fully. Let your light be genuine, warm and balanced. Rest is part of radiance.
ctx.advice: Step into the light. Share your gifts openly, play, celebrate your wins, and get outside. Approach your situation with optimism and honesty, and let your enthusiasm open doors. Make room for fun, sunlight and simple pleasures; they will refresh your perspective and remind you why it all matters.
ctx.self: You feel confident, energetic and more like yourself than in a while. Your inner child is happy. Trust that radiance; it is your natural state. Like the children dancing on the green hill, you have permission to be playful, curious and fully alive, without needing to earn it.
ctx.others: Others see you as warm, bright and successful. Or someone in your environment brings joy and light to the situation, a friend, a child or a generous mentor whose presence lifts everyone. Their light invites you to step forward too.
ctx.hopes: You hope for happiness, success and freedom. You may fear that good fortune will not last. The Sun says enjoy it fully; joy is renewable when you keep living from your truth. Share it, and it grows.
ctx.love: In love, the Sun brings happiness, warmth and openness. Relationships flourish through play, honesty and shared joy. Singles shine and attract genuinely good connections. Laughter, shared adventures and simple affection are the glue now. Let yourself be seen fully, and allow your partner the same freedom to shine.
ctx.work: At work, success and recognition are favoured. Creative projects, leadership and public-facing work shine. Your enthusiasm and clarity draw support, and efforts begin to bear fruit. This is a good moment to step forward, pitch an idea, or take visible leadership. Generosity with credit will make your success even brighter.
ctx.spirit: Spirit shines through you as pure life and light. You are a child of the new dawn, free to create and celebrate. Let your inner sun rise and illuminate everything you touch. Light, life, love and liberty are your birthright.
ctx.release: Release self-doubt and the habit of hiding your light. Let go of old gloom, guilt or seriousness that no longer serve you. You are allowed to be happy. Like the sun burning off morning mist, let the old shadows lift. Joy is not frivolous; it is fuel.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be pride, or a reluctance to admit vulnerability. Or you may be dimming yourself so as not to outshine others. Shine honestly, and let others shine too. The sun gives light to all equally.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a basic sense of vitality and self-worth. Reconnecting to the simple joy of being alive steadies everything built above it. Like the children on the green hill, your deepest ground is a simple delight in being here. When you remember that, ambition and effort find their proper place.
ctx.gift: Your gift is radiance and optimism, the warmth that makes people and projects grow. Your joy is contagious and can turn the whole situation around. Like the sun that warms every living thing without asking for anything in return, your generous spirit brightens every room you walk into.

name: XX · The Aeon
title: The Aeon
imagery: The star-bodied sky goddess Nuit arches over the scene, and beneath her the winged globe of Hadit glows with fire. Within this embrace sits Horus, the crowned child-god of the new age, enthroned, with a translucent child form standing before him, finger to lips. At the base, the Hebrew letter Shin rises like three flames, each holding a figure being born into new life.
meaning: Crowley replaced Judgement with the Aeon, the dawning of a new age of consciousness, the Aeon of Horus, centred on the individual will and the freedom of the child. In a reading, it is the call to wake up and step into a new chapter of your life. Old ways of thinking give way to a fresh, more authentic vision. It asks you to evaluate where you have been, but mainly to rise into who you are becoming. Something in you is being reborn; answer the call.
numerology: Twenty reduces to two, the dawn of awareness and partnership with something greater; as twice ten, it is completion doubled, a whole new cycle on a higher level.
affirmation: I answer the call to become who I truly am.

ctx.past: A powerful awakening in your past changed your direction. Perhaps you outgrew an old worldview or answered a calling. That turning point still shapes how you see yourself and what you value. The flames of Shin that lit the way then still burn.
ctx.present: You are at the threshold of a new era in your life. The heart of the matter is awakening: seeing yourself and your situation in a fresh light. Old frameworks are dissolving, and a new sense of purpose is rising.
ctx.future: A new chapter is dawning. Expect a calling, an important decision, or a shift in consciousness that makes old concerns feel small. You will see clearly where you are heading and why. Like the child Horus, you will step forward with fresh eyes.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is resistance to growth or self-judgement that keeps you stuck. You may be clinging to an old identity or waiting for permission to change. The new era has already begun; step into it.
ctx.advice: Answer the call. Review what you have learned, release what belongs to the old chapter, and commit to the new direction. Trust your evolving vision, even if others do not yet understand. The new chapter rewards courage more than caution.
ctx.self: You feel yourself changing, perhaps quickly, with a growing sense of purpose and freedom. You are becoming more yourself. Honour that process; it is a genuine rebirth. Like the child of the new aeon, you are curious, open and ready to meet life on your own terms. Let that fresh innocence be your guide.
ctx.others: Others may notice that you have changed and may need time to catch up. Or someone around you is a messenger or catalyst, pointing you toward the next chapter. Listen to what they reveal. Their words may light the way.
ctx.hopes: You hope for renewal and a meaningful new start. You may fear being judged or leaving the familiar behind. The Aeon says the new beginning is worth it; you are being called forward, not tested.
ctx.love: In love, the Aeon brings a new level of honesty and freedom. Relationships may transform, deepening into something more authentic, or you may realise what you truly need. Reconciliation and renewal are possible. Let old wounds be healed in this new light.
ctx.work: At work, a calling or career shift is in the air. You may be drawn toward more meaningful work or a new approach. Take stock of your skills, and move toward work that matches who you are becoming.
ctx.spirit: Spirit announces a new aeon within you. The child of the future is being born in your heart, free, curious and full of Will. Trust this awakening; it is the next step in your evolution.
ctx.release: Release old guilt, past judgements and outdated beliefs. Let go of the version of yourself you have outgrown. The past has done its work; it no longer defines you. Like the figures rising from the flames of Shin, you can step out of the old form entirely and into something more alive.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of your own potential, or harsh self-judgement keeping you from rising. Be compassionate with yourself; growth is not a test you can fail. The child in you is not afraid to try; let that boldness guide you a little more often.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies an awakening or call that has been building beneath the surface. Acknowledging it gives meaning to everything else in the situation. Like the fire of Shin under the whole card, this call is the spark beneath everything. Once you name what is calling you, the next steps become clearer.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to renew yourself and see with fresh eyes. You can rise from old patterns into a new life. That capacity for awakening inspires others too. Like the child Horus, you carry a fresh perspective and a willingness to begin anew, and you light the path for those who follow.

name: XXI · The Universe
title: The Universe
imagery: A dancing woman whirls within an ellipse of light, holding a sickle-like crescent of energy and wrestling playfully with a great serpent that spirals around her. Above her shines an eye, while the four kerubic beasts, bull, lion, eagle and human, mark the corners. Beneath lies a diagram of the elements of matter, showing that the dance encompasses the whole created world.
meaning: The Universe is the final card of the major arcana and the completion of the Great Work. It shows the whole of creation in a dance, every element and force woven into a single, living pattern. Ruled by Saturn, it is mastery earned through time, structure and patience. This card signals completion, fulfilment and the integration of everything you have learned, but also the start of a new cycle, as the dancer turns once more. Celebrate how far you have come, and step forward knowing you are whole.
numerology: Twenty-one reduces to three, creative fullness; as three times seven, it seals the journey through the major arcana in perfect completion.
affirmation: I am whole, and I dance freely through every cycle of my life.

ctx.past: In your past, you completed an important cycle, finishing a project, a life stage or a long journey. That achievement gave you a sense of wholeness and mastery that still supports you now. It proved that you can see things through to the end.
ctx.present: You are completing something significant. The heart of the matter is integration: bringing everything together and recognising your own accomplishment. This is a moment to celebrate and to take stock. Look back at how far you have come; the pattern of your journey is finally visible.
ctx.future: Fulfilment and completion are on the horizon. A long effort will reach its natural end, bringing satisfaction and a sense of wholeness. Then a new cycle will begin, built on everything you have learned. The dancer never stops moving.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is resistance to completion, either holding on because you fear the next chapter, or rushing to start something new without honouring what you have finished. Let the dance end gracefully. Every ending deserves its moment of rest and gratitude.
ctx.advice: Finish what you started, tie up loose ends and celebrate the result. Integrate your lessons. When you are ready, take a step into the new cycle with confidence and freedom. Then let the next dance begin, without rushing.
ctx.self: You feel accomplished, centred and at peace with who you are. You have integrated many experiences, and you move with greater ease. Trust your sense of wholeness. Like the dancer in the ellipse, you are free within your own form, held and supported by everything you have built.
ctx.others: Others see you as capable, accomplished and complete. Or someone in your environment represents mastery and wisdom, helping you see the bigger picture of your journey. They may look to you for perspective, guidance or a model of how to finish well, and your example quietly encourages them.
ctx.hopes: You hope for fulfilment, closure and a sense that it was all worthwhile. You may fear that endings mean loss. The Universe says completion is a gift, and every end is a new beginning. Wholeness is already here.
ctx.love: In love, the Universe brings fulfilment and harmony. Relationships may reach a new level, such as commitment, or a natural completion. Wholeness within yourself makes your connections more joyful. Two whole people dance best together, each moving freely within the shared rhythm.
ctx.work: At work, the Universe signals completion and success: a finished project, a goal reached, or international or wide-ranging opportunities. Recognise your achievements and prepare for the next phase. Saturn rewards the patience and discipline you have shown, so let your track record speak for you.
ctx.spirit: Spirit shows you that you are part of the great cosmic dance. Every experience fits into the whole, and nothing has been wasted. You are complete, and you are always beginning again. Saturn's patient time has shaped you well.
ctx.release: Release the need to keep striving when the work is done. Let go of unfinished business that keeps you tied to the past. Celebrate, then move on. The serpent sheds its skin; you can shed old striving the same way, with grace and without regret.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of success or of what comes after achievement. Or you may not be acknowledging how much you have accomplished. Allow yourself to see the whole picture. There is nothing to prove anymore; simply enjoy the dance.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a long journey of growth and patient effort. Recognising that foundation brings a deep sense of wholeness and peace. Like Saturn's slow, steady hand, it has been shaping you all along. Every step, every setback and every lesson has been part of a single coherent pattern.
ctx.gift: Your gift is integration and mastery: the ability to bring all parts together and move with grace. That sense of completeness lets you start new cycles with confidence. Like the dancer in the cosmic ellipse, you can hold many forces at once and still move freely and joyfully.

name: Ace of Wands
title: Root of the Powers of Fire
imagery: A great rough-hewn club, more like a living torch than a tool, blazes upward out of a dark sky. Its flames break into ten tongues of fire arranged like the Tree of Life, and bolts of lightning crackle around it. It is the pure, untamed lightning of the Will before it has chosen any shape at all.
meaning: The Ace of Wands is the root of the powers of Fire, the first strike of the match in the dark. In Crowley’s deck it is not a polished wand but a primitive club, natural and unstoppable, because true Will grows like a tree rather than being manufactured. When it appears, a surge of vitality, desire and creative ambition is rising in you, often before you know exactly what it is for. This is energy, not yet a plan: it wants to be aimed, honoured and given fuel. Say yes to the spark, then give it a direction worthy of its heat.
astrology: Root of Fire · Kether in Atziluth (the Ace rules the heavens around the north pole)
numerology: The Ace is Kether, the One, the crown of the Tree: pure undivided force from which every other number of the suit unfolds.
affirmation: My Will is a living flame, and I choose where it burns.

ctx.past: A sudden flare of inspiration started all this. Something lit you up, an idea, a calling or an attraction, and you moved on it with more instinct than strategy. That first spark still lives under the current situation, and it is worth remembering how alive it made you feel.
ctx.present: Raw fire is pouring through you right now. You may feel restless, excited, even a little dangerous with possibility. The heart of the matter is a fresh impulse of Will that is asking to be acted on rather than analysed to death.
ctx.future: A burst of energy is on its way: a new project, a passion or a breakthrough that comes like lightning. Expect motivation to return and doors to open quickly. Be ready to catch the spark and feed it while it is hot.
ctx.challenge: Pure fire with no channel scorches everything nearby. The challenge is impatience, burnout or a flood of ideas you never ground. This card asks you to choose one flame to tend instead of setting the whole field alight.
ctx.advice: Act on the spark today, even in a small way. Write the first page, send the message, light the candle. Fire grows by being fed, so give your inspiration a single concrete step and watch how quickly it answers.
ctx.self: You are running hot with desire and drive, more alive than you have felt in a while. Trust that vitality. You do not need permission to want something fiercely; you need only the honesty to name it.
ctx.others: Others feel your heat. You may come across as magnetic, bold or intense, the person who gets things moving. Someone around you might also be the spark-bringer, stirring the group awake with fresh enthusiasm. Let that energy catch, but keep your own flame yours.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a reason to feel truly alive again, a cause or creation worthy of your fire. You may fear that same intensity, worried that once lit it will burn out of control. Both reveal how much power is waiting in you.
ctx.love: In love this is instant chemistry, attraction that arrives like a lit fuse. Passion, flirtation and renewed desire are strongly favoured. In an existing bond, it calls for bold gestures that rekindle the original flame.
ctx.work: At work, a new initiative or creative venture is ready to ignite. Pitch the idea, start the side project, claim the role that excites you. Energy is high, so pair it with one practical plan to keep it from fizzling.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks in the language of fire: your True Will is stirring. The divine message is that the life force wants to move through you, not around you. Honour your desire as something sacred rather than selfish.
ctx.release: Let go of the habit of waiting until you feel fully qualified. Release damp, half-hearted commitments that smother your spark. The flame needs air, so clear away what has been crowding it. Old embers of resentment or boredom can go too; they only make smoke where you want light.
ctx.shadow: Underneath may lie a fear of your own power, a sense that wanting too much is unsafe. Or you may be chasing new sparks to avoid tending the fires you already lit. Look honestly at which is true.
ctx.foundation: At the root is raw desire, a creative or vital impulse that set everything in motion. Whatever has grown since then rests on that original flash of Will. Return to it when you lose your way.
ctx.gift: Your gift is ignition. You can start things, wake people up and turn a dull room electric. Hidden help arrives through inspiration itself: ideas, dreams and sudden certainties that seem to come from beyond you.

name: Two of Wands
title: Dominion
imagery: Two Tibetan dorjes, the thunderbolts of spiritual power, cross at the centre with flames leaping from their ends against a red field. Their fierce demon-faced heads show that this power is ancient and not entirely tame. Together they make an image of Will that has found its first direction and claimed its ground.
meaning: Dominion is Mars in Aries, the war-god in his own sign, and it is the first time the fire of the Ace takes a definite shape. This is the energy of claiming: deciding what is yours to rule and stepping into it boldly. Crowley saw here the Will in its most ideal form, fresh, courageous and not yet worn by compromise. The card asks you to lead your own life rather than wait for conditions to invite you. Use this force with clarity, because Mars in Aries can conquer gloriously or simply bulldoze. Choose your territory, and then hold it.
numerology: Two is Chokmah, Wisdom, the first outward thrust of force; in Fire it is Will discovering that it can act.
affirmation: I claim my ground and lead my own life with courage.

ctx.past: There was a moment you took charge, drew a line and said this is mine. That act of dominion shaped everything since. Your past boldness is still paying dividends, even if you had to fight for it.
ctx.present: You have the power and the authority right now; the question is how you will use it. The heart of the matter is ownership. Step fully into the role you already hold instead of hovering at the threshold.
ctx.future: A time of command is approaching. You will be in a position to decide, direct and lead. Expect your initiative to be met with results, as long as you move decisively rather than half-heartedly. The thunderbolt is yours to wield, so decide in advance what you want to build with it.
ctx.challenge: Mars in his own sign can turn domineering. The obstacle may be aggression, impatience, or a need to win at any cost. Leadership asks you to rule yourself first, especially your temper. A crossed dorje strikes both ways, so check that your force is not wounding the very things you want to protect.
ctx.advice: Make the decision and own it. Take the initiative before someone else defines the territory for you. Speak plainly, set your terms and let your actions show that you mean it. Waiting for a sign only hands your power to circumstance, so move first.
ctx.self: You feel ready to lead and capable of shaping your circumstances. There is a warrior’s confidence in you right now. Trust it, while staying honest about whether you are fighting for something or just fighting.
ctx.others: Others see you as strong-willed and in command, someone not easily pushed around. Your environment may contain a forceful person whose ambition rubs against your own. Respect each other’s territory. Where wills collide, a frank conversation about who owns what will spare you a needless war.
ctx.hopes: You hope to finally be in charge of your own destiny. You may fear the responsibility that comes with power, or the conflict that claiming it might bring. Both are signs you are ready. The Ram does not ask whether it is allowed to charge, and neither need you.
ctx.love: In love, passion is bold and direct. Someone may pursue you with clear intent, or you may be the one who makes the first move. Beware of power struggles; the healthiest dominion here is mutual devotion freely chosen.
ctx.work: At work this is the card of the entrepreneur and the leader. Launch, pitch, negotiate and take responsibility. Your drive can open new territory, so plan your campaign rather than charging every hill. Map out where you want to be in a year, then strike for it.
ctx.spirit: Spirit honours your sovereignty. Your Will is not an accident; it is your soul’s way of moving through the world. The message is to rule your inner kingdom with courage and integrity. Mars in Aries is sacred fire when it serves something larger than the ego, so dedicate your strength to a purpose you believe in.
ctx.release: Release the urge to control every outcome or every person. Let go of battles that do not serve your true aim. Dominion means mastery, not micromanagement. Let go also of the fear that your strength will push people away; those who belong in your kingdom will welcome a ruler who knows her mind.
ctx.shadow: A hidden fear of being powerless may drive an excess of force. Or you may be shrinking from authority you secretly crave. Notice where you either grip too hard or refuse to grip at all.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a decision to act, a moment when Will chose a direction. This situation grew out of that fierce choice, and its strength still holds the structure together. If things feel shaky, go back to that first decision and ask whether you still stand behind it with your whole heart.
ctx.gift: Your gift is courage. You can take the first step that others hesitate over and make things real by sheer resolve. Hidden help arrives when you stand up clearly for what you want. When you plant your flag, people and resources rally to it.

name: Three of Wands
title: Virtue
imagery: Three wands crowned with lotus blossoms cross in a burst of golden-orange light, flames and rays streaming out between them like the first sun of spring. The lotuses show that fire has learned to flower rather than simply burn. It is an image of strength that is calm, radiant and sure of itself.
meaning: Virtue is the Sun in Aries, the season when the light returns and life surges upward with confidence. In Crowley’s sense, virtue is not prim goodness but manly and womanly power, the inner integrity that comes from being true to your Will. The idea of the Two has now become established and begins to bear fruit. You are standing on solid ground of your own making, and your energy is steady rather than frantic. This card blesses self-respect, honest ambition and the quiet authority of someone who knows who they are. Let your character be your strategy.
numerology: Three is Binah, Understanding, where force first gains form; in Fire the Will becomes a stable, fruitful quality.
affirmation: I act from integrity, and my strength grows in the light.

ctx.past: You built this on honest effort and self-belief. Earlier choices that were true to your values established a strength you can still lean on. The roots of your current confidence are sound. Trust what you built back then; it was made of good material, and it will hold more weight than you fear.
ctx.present: You are in a period of steady, sunny power. Things you started are taking hold, and you feel more like yourself. The heart of the matter is integrity: act in line with who you are and growth follows.
ctx.future: A season of flourishing is coming. Efforts will begin to show results and your reputation will rest on solid ground. Expect your confidence to be rewarded with real progress. Like a spring morning after a long winter, the light is returning to your efforts and the warmth will last.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of Virtue is pride, the belief that being right excuses everything. The challenge may be rigidity or self-righteousness. True strength stays humble enough to keep learning. Notice if you are lecturing rather than living your values, or holding others to standards you quietly bend for yourself.
ctx.advice: Act from your principles, not from fear of what others think. Take the honest path even when a shortcut beckons. Let your work and your word carry their own authority. Stand in the sun of your own character and let it guide each choice, especially the small and unseen ones.
ctx.self: You are standing tall, sure of your worth and your aims. That self-respect is earned. Let it shine without needing to prove it to anyone. The lotuses on these wands show fire learning to flower; you are learning that confidence can be gentle as well as bright.
ctx.others: Others see you as dependable, warm and quietly powerful. Your example inspires trust. Someone in your circle may also model the integrity you are growing into. Your steadiness lights a path for them, so keep tending it, and do not be surprised when people seek your counsel or your help.
ctx.hopes: You hope to live in a way that matches your values and to be respected for it. You may fear that honesty will cost you. In the long run, Virtue tends to be its own reward.
ctx.love: In love, this is affection built on respect and shared values. A partner may admire your strength of character, and the bond feels warm and steady. Let pride never get in the way of tenderness.
ctx.work: At work, your reliability and competence are your best assets. Projects launched earlier are ready to expand. Lead by example and keep your business dealings clean and above board. Partners and clients will judge you by your consistency, so let your track record do the persuading.
ctx.spirit: Spirit reminds you that the sun lives within you. Your Will, aligned with your nature, is a holy light. The divine message is to be true, and the way will open. When your actions match your inner truth, you become a channel for the returning sun, warm and unhurried.
ctx.release: Release self-doubt and the old habit of shrinking your light to make others comfortable. Let go too of any need to be seen as perfect. Virtue is wholeness, not flawlessness. Release the inner critic that tells you your good is never good enough; it has no place in a season of flowering.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath might be a quiet arrogance, or a fear of being judged that you cover with correctness. Check whether your principles are serving life or simply shielding you. The difference shows in how you treat people who disagree with you, so let that be your quiet test this week.
ctx.foundation: This situation rests on a foundation of personal integrity. Your character, not luck, is what holds it together. That is a sturdy root to build from. Whatever wobbles above it, the base is sound, so check your values before you change your strategy.
ctx.gift: Your gift is radiant confidence grounded in character. People trust you, and doors open because of who you are. Hidden help comes through allies who recognise your honesty. That reputation is a lantern you can carry into any new venture, and it lights the way for people who come after you.

name: Four of Wands
title: Completion
imagery: Four wands cross to form a wheel within a ring of flame, each topped at one end with a ram’s head and at the other with the dove of Venus. The circle closes the energy so it can rest and circulate. The ram and dove together show fiery Aries tempered by the gentle harmony of Venus.
meaning: Completion is Venus in Aries, the fierce energy of the Ram softened into graceful order. The work started in the Ace has reached a stable form, and for a moment everything fits. This is the card of finishing, settling and celebrating what has been built, not because nothing more will happen, but because a cycle has rounded off well. Crowley noted that Venus brings tact and gentleness so the fire does not exhaust itself. Pause, take stock, and enjoy the harmony you have created. Completion is a resting point that gives you strength for the next turn of the wheel.
numerology: Four is Chesed, Mercy, the first stable structure; in Fire it is energy organised and brought to a peaceful close.
affirmation: I honour what I have completed and let myself rest in its harmony.

ctx.past: A chapter came to a satisfying close not long ago. You finished something, settled into a home or a role, and found a measure of peace. That harmony is still a resource you can draw from.
ctx.present: Things have come together. The heart of the matter is a sense of arrival: a project done, a relationship stable, a structure in place. Let yourself feel it instead of rushing on. The ram and the dove are at peace on this card, and for now your own drive and tenderness can sit together too.
ctx.future: A cycle is about to complete. Expect a milestone, a celebration or a sense that the pieces finally fit. It is a good outcome, and a solid platform for whatever comes next. Plan something to honour it, even a simple dinner or a candle lit with thanks, because marking the moment helps you absorb it.
ctx.challenge: Completion can tip into complacency, or into clinging to an order that is ready to change. The challenge may be resisting the next cycle. Enjoy the rest, but do not mistake it for the end of growth.
ctx.advice: Mark the milestone. Celebrate, gather people, tidy loose ends and put the finishing touches on what you have made. Tact and grace will smooth any remaining friction. A small ritual of closure, like a toast or a written thank-you, seals the energy so it can nourish the next beginning.
ctx.self: You feel settled and capable, perhaps proud of how far you have come. Your fire has found a home. Let yourself be content without feeling guilty about it. This is the harvest of real effort. Allow yourself to sit in the circle of what you have made and simply enjoy being here.
ctx.others: Others see you as someone who gets things done and keeps the peace. Your environment may be warm and welcoming, a circle that celebrates together. Enjoy the community you have built. Open your door and share the warmth; harmony grows stronger when it is enjoyed with friends and family around the table.
ctx.hopes: You hope for stability and the feeling that things are finally complete. You may fear that once you rest, momentum will be lost. Trust that a well-built structure holds its own energy. The wheel turns whether you push it or not, and right now it is turning in your favour.
ctx.love: In love, this suggests commitment, a home together, or a joyful milestone. Passion and tenderness balance each other well. It is a lovely card for moving in, celebrating or simply enjoying what you share. Let your home be a place where both passion and peace are welcome.
ctx.work: At work, a project reaches completion and can be presented or delivered. Systems are in order. Take a moment to recognise your team’s efforts before charging into the next goal. A well-run system you set up now will keep serving you long after the celebration ends, so document what worked.
ctx.spirit: Spirit invites you into the harmony of the circle. The message is that endings are sacred too, and that rest is part of the creative cycle. Give thanks for what has been fulfilled. Like the wheel on this card, every completion carries the seed of a new cycle, so rest in trust rather than in worry.
ctx.release: Release the drive to keep pushing when the work is done. Let go of perfectionism that will not let you call something finished. Some things are complete exactly as they are. Let go of the restless voice that says celebration must be earned twice. You have finished, and that is enough for today.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear that peace is boring, or an unease with happiness that makes you look for the next problem. Ask whether you are allowing yourself to enjoy what you have. Peace can feel unfamiliar after long effort, and the mind may invent trouble to fill the quiet. Let the quiet stay quiet.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a well-built structure, something you completed with care. The situation rests on that stable base, and it is stronger than you might think. When doubts arise, remember the effort that went into it, and lean on what you have already proven.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to bring things to a graceful finish and create harmony from effort. Hidden help comes through celebrations, gatherings and the goodwill of your community. You know how to finish well, which is rarer than it sounds and makes you a good companion for any long venture.

name: Five of Wands
title: Strife
imagery: The heavy central wand of the Chief Adept, crowned with a winged sun and serpents, is crossed by the phoenix-headed wands of the Second Adept and the lotus wands of the Third. Dark flames burn behind them in a cramped, tense pattern. The image shows energies of different rank and purpose straining against one another.
meaning: Strife is Saturn in Leo: the heavy hand of limitation pressing down on the proud, radiant lion. Energy that wants to shine meets resistance, delay or competition, and sparks fly. The stability of the Four has been disturbed so that something can move again, and the struggle, though uncomfortable, is not pointless. This card asks you to use friction as a forge rather than a wound. Clarify what you are actually fighting for, and stop wasting force on squabbles that do not matter. Strife strengthens those who stay honest and keep their fire focused.
numerology: Five is Geburah, Severity, the force that disrupts stability so life can move; in Fire it brings conflict and testing.
affirmation: I use friction to sharpen my fire, not to burn myself out.

ctx.past: There was a period of conflict or struggle that shaped where you are now. Competition or friction tested you. Whatever it cost, it also showed you what you are willing to fight for. Honour the scars, and keep the lessons without carrying the grudges.
ctx.present: Energies are clashing right now, inside you or around you. The heart of the matter is tension: competing aims, egos or obligations pulling different ways. It is uncomfortable, but it is also movement. Ask which wand is yours and which belong to others, and let that guide where you push and where you yield.
ctx.future: A stretch of challenge or competition is coming. Expect obstacles, debates or delays that test your resolve. Meet them with clear purpose and they will make you stronger. Saturn’s pressure tempers fire into steel, so treat each obstacle as part of your training.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is endless struggle for its own sake, pride that turns every disagreement into a battle. Saturn presses on the lion’s vanity. Ask what is worth the fight and lay down the rest. Stepping back is not defeat; it is strategy.
ctx.advice: Pick your battles. Focus your energy on the one conflict that truly matters and let the petty ones go. Where you must engage, be direct, fair and steady rather than reactive. Clear conversation is worth more than clever tactics now, and a little humour can cool a room surprisingly fast.
ctx.self: You may feel frustrated, hemmed in or provoked. Your fire wants to shine and keeps hitting walls. Remember that resistance is building your strength, even if it does not feel that way. Breathe before you react, and let frustration become focus instead of fuel for another argument.
ctx.others: Others may seem competitive, argumentative or blocking. Your environment is charged with ego and opinion. Remember that everyone is struggling with their own Saturn, and do not take every spark personally. A calm word from you could change the whole tone of the group, and the adepts on this card are, after all, meant to work together.
ctx.hopes: You hope to prove yourself and win recognition. You may fear being overshadowed or defeated. Both reveal how much your pride is invested, and how much you could learn by letting it soften. Ask what you would fight for even if no one ever saw it.
ctx.love: In love, friction and arguments may flare, often over pride or control. This can be passionate sparring or exhausting conflict. Choose honesty over winning and the heat can become closeness instead of distance. Listen for the real need beneath the quarrel, which is often simply the wish to be seen and valued.
ctx.work: At work, competition is fierce or the team pulls in different directions. Delays and red tape may frustrate you. Clarify roles and goals, and let healthy rivalry push the quality of your work higher. Turn rivals into collaborators where you can.
ctx.spirit: Spirit says that struggle is part of the soul’s refining. Saturn’s weight teaches discipline to the radiant self. The message is to keep your heart warm while your will is tested. The adepts’ wands clash so that each can learn its true rank, and you too are learning where your power truly belongs.
ctx.release: Release petty rivalries and the need to be right. Let go of fights that belong to someone else. Your fire is precious; stop spending it on smoke. Release the scoreboard in your head as well. Not every slight needs an answer, and peace is sometimes the bravest move you can make.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be an appetite for drama, or a wounded pride that reads every challenge as an attack. Look at what part of you actually enjoys the fight. Conflict can feel like aliveness when life is too quiet, so seek other ways to feel your fire burning.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a clash of wills or a pressure that disturbed a previous balance. The situation is driven by that friction, and understanding it is the key to resolving it. Name the competing forces honestly, and you can begin to arrange them instead of being torn between them.
ctx.gift: Your gift is resilience under pressure. Conflict sharpens you, and you can learn quickly when tested. Hidden help comes through worthy opponents who push you to grow. You come out of a struggle wiser and tougher than you went in, and you can help others find their footing in a storm.

name: Six of Wands
title: Victory
imagery: Six wands, the phoenix, lotus and winged-sun wands of the Adepts, cross in perfect symmetry with nine flames burning steadily between them on a violet ground. The struggle of the Five has resolved into order. Every kind of power now works together, and the fire burns clean and bright.
meaning: Victory is Jupiter in Leo: the planet of generosity and good fortune shining in the sign of the proud, generous lion. After the strife of the Five, balance returns and the effort is crowned with success. This is the card of winning, being recognised and feeling the glow of achievement shared with others. The six sits at Tiphareth, the heart of the Tree, so this is victory that is harmonious rather than ruthless. Enjoy it fully and give credit where it is due. A gracious winner keeps winning, because the fire is fed by goodwill.
numerology: Six is Tiphareth, Beauty, the harmonious heart of the Tree; in Fire it is energy balanced and triumphant.
affirmation: I accept my victory with a generous heart.

ctx.past: A past success built your confidence and reputation. You overcame something and were seen for it. That victory still opens doors and reminds you what you are capable of. Remember how it felt to win, and let that memory steady you whenever doubt creeps back in or a new challenge looks too big.
ctx.present: You are winning, or very close to it. The heart of the matter is recognition and success after effort. Let yourself receive the applause instead of brushing it away. All the wands are working together now, and the balance you have found between effort and ease is the real prize.
ctx.future: Victory is coming. Expect good news, public recognition, or a goal finally reached. The outcome is bright, especially if you stay generous and keep your team with you. Jupiter in Leo is generous, so expect the rewards to reach beyond you and to touch the people who believed in you along the way.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of Victory is ego and dependence on praise. The challenge may be arrogance, or feeling empty when the applause fades. Let success be a station on the road, not your whole identity. The lion loves an audience, so give yours thanks instead of demands.
ctx.advice: Step forward and claim your success. Share the news, accept the reward and thank those who helped. Confidence now will carry you into the next opportunity. Then turn to look at what you can build with the trust you have earned. Victory is a door, and you are now invited to walk through it.
ctx.self: You feel capable, proud and seen. Your efforts have been validated. Carry this confidence gracefully and let it inspire rather than intimidate those around you. You have earned this, and acknowledging it plainly is not vanity but honesty. Stand in the glow for a while without explaining it away.
ctx.others: Others see you as a winner, a leader worth following. Your environment is supportive and celebratory. People are cheering you on, so let them. Your success reflects well on everyone around you. Enjoy the shared joy, and remember to lift up those who carried a wand beside you.
ctx.hopes: You hope for recognition and triumph after long effort. You may fear failing in public or being envied once you succeed. Victory asks you to be big enough for your own success. Be ready to hold the success you ask for, with a steady heart and an open hand.
ctx.love: In love, this is a joyful, proud relationship, the kind you want to show the world. A romantic hope may be fulfilled. Celebrate each other generously and keep ego out of the way. A shared win can bring you closer than ever.
ctx.work: At work, a promotion, award or successful launch is indicated. Your reputation rises. Share the credit and use your momentum to secure the next goal. Jupiter favours expansion, so this is a good moment to propose the next step, ask for resources or widen your reach.
ctx.spirit: Spirit celebrates with you. The message is that your Will, balanced and harmonised, naturally succeeds. Victory is the sign that your inner forces are aligned. Give thanks, because gratitude keeps the fire clean. The light that wins today is the same light that will guide you tomorrow.
ctx.release: Release false modesty and the habit of downplaying your wins. Let go too of any need for constant approval. Your worth is not measured by applause. Release too the fear that this will be taken away. Good fortune grows when it is received with an open heart rather than a clenched fist.
ctx.shadow: Hidden may be a fear that success will isolate you, or an ego that needs more praise than it admits. Notice whether you can enjoy victory without needing to be the only winner. A true victory has room for many winners, and sharing the spotlight will not dim your own light one bit.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is a hard-won success, harmony restored after struggle. That achievement is the platform everything rests on. When things wobble, return to the balance and generosity that made the win possible in the first place. That spirit is the real root of your success.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to rally people and win with grace. Hidden help comes through supporters, good luck and the generous ripple of Jupiter’s favour. You know how to turn effort into triumph. Use that gift to lift others too, and the fire will keep growing.

name: Seven of Wands
title: Valour
imagery: A single rough, heavy club, like the primitive Ace, is thrust across six slender wands of the Adepts against a dark indigo ground with fierce flames. The refined order of the Six is broken, and plain raw courage takes the front. It is the image of one fighter facing many with nothing but nerve.
meaning: Valour is Mars in Leo: the warrior in the sign of the lion, bold and brave but somewhat disorganised. The balance of the Six has been lost, and now you must rely on sheer courage rather than strategy or support. Crowley saw this as a battle that can still be won, but only through individual pluck and resolve. The card asks you to hold your ground, defend what you believe in, and trust your own fighting spirit even when you feel outnumbered. Courage, not perfection, is what carries the day here.
numerology: Seven is Netzach, Victory of feeling and instinct, a sphere that unbalances the Tree; in Fire it calls for raw courage.
affirmation: I stand my ground with courage, and my courage is enough.

ctx.past: You once stood your ground when it would have been easier to give in. That act of courage shaped your path. You learned you can face opposition and survive it. Remember that version of yourself; the one who refused to fold is still here and still ready to stand.
ctx.present: You are holding a position under pressure. The heart of the matter is courage: defending your choices, values or territory when others push back. Your nerve is your best weapon now. You do not need everyone on your side to be right, and you do not need perfect odds to hold this line.
ctx.future: A challenge is coming that will test your mettle. You may feel outnumbered or under-prepared. Expect to win through bravery and determination rather than perfect planning. The rough club on this card is a reminder that heart can outweigh polish. You will find out how much fight you really have.
ctx.challenge: Valour can become stubborn defiance or a chip on the shoulder. The obstacle may be fighting battles out of habit or pride. Courage includes knowing when to change ground. Retreat with honour is sometimes the bravest choice, and it leaves you fresh for the battles that truly matter.
ctx.advice: Hold your position and speak up for what matters to you. Do not wait for the perfect plan or a full army. Act with conviction, and improvise boldly as you go. Mars in Leo rewards those who show up fully, so let your heart lead the charge and trust your instincts under fire.
ctx.self: You feel like the underdog but you are not backing down. There is fire in your belly. Trust it, while staying aware that not every challenger is an enemy. The courage you feel is real, and it is enough to see you through, even if you cannot yet see how the fight will end.
ctx.others: Others may be questioning or challenging you. Your environment might feel competitive or hostile. Some people respect your boldness more than they let on. Stay firm but fair. Respect earned through steady courage lasts far longer than any victory won by shouting.
ctx.hopes: You hope to prove you can stand alone. You may fear being overwhelmed or criticised. Both point to a deep reserve of strength you are only beginning to tap. Courage is not the absence of fear; it is acting while you still feel it.
ctx.love: In love, you may need to defend your relationship, your choices or your own needs. Courage is called for, whether to speak honestly or to stand by someone. Do not let defensiveness become a wall between you. Love worth having is worth standing up for, and the bravest move may simply be saying what you truly feel.
ctx.work: At work, competition is stiff or your ideas face resistance. Stand by your expertise and push your proposal through. Bold action wins, even with limited resources. Keep your eye on your goal and be ready to defend your position with facts and passion. Your persistence will be noticed by the right people.
ctx.spirit: Spirit honours the lion-hearted. The message is that your soul has the courage it needs. Stand in your truth and let it be your shield. Your guides remind you that you are never truly fighting alone. Their strength flows into your arm when you stand for what is right.
ctx.release: Release the belief that you need everyone’s approval to act. Let go of exhausting fights that do not truly threaten anything you value. Release the fear of being seen as difficult, too. Standing up for yourself is not a fault, and you do not have to apologise for it.
ctx.shadow: Hidden may be a habit of seeing yourself as embattled, which keeps you braced for attack. Ask whether you are defending your truth or defending a wound. Not every question is an attack, and lowering your guard with the right people might show you that you have more allies than you thought.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a stand you chose to take. The situation grew from that act of conviction, and it still depends on you not giving way. Honour that choice, and check that it still reflects what you value. If it does, keep standing; if not, choose your ground again.
ctx.gift: Your gift is raw courage. You can face what others flee from and rally when the odds look poor. Hidden help comes through your own unshakeable nerve. That nerve is not loud or showy, but it is steady and true, and it will carry you through the hardest moments you face.

name: Eight of Wands
title: Swiftness
imagery: Eight wands have become bolts of electric light, zigzagging across a geometric prism of crystal, with a rainbow arching above. The fire here has turned into pure current, travelling at the speed of thought. The rainbow shows that this energy is also a bridge, carrying light from one place to another.
meaning: Swiftness is Mercury in Sagittarius: the quick messenger god riding the arrow of the Archer. Energy that was struggling or fighting now moves at high velocity, as ideas, messages, travel and sudden understanding. Crowley linked it with light and electricity, energy so fast it becomes communication itself. This card signals that things are about to happen quickly, so be ready to respond and stay flexible. Aim your thoughts clearly, because whatever you send out now travels far. It is a time for decisive messages, rapid progress and the thrill of momentum.
numerology: Eight is Hod, Splendour, the sphere of Mercury and intellect; in Fire it is will become swift thought and communication.
affirmation: I move with the current, and my ideas fly true.

ctx.past: Things moved very fast not long ago. A burst of news, travel or sudden decisions swept you forward. That rapid momentum set much of the present in motion. Notice which of those swift choices still serve you, and which could use a second look now that the dust has settled.
ctx.present: Events are accelerating. The heart of the matter is speed: messages, ideas and opportunities arriving faster than you can file them. Stay alert and responsive, and keep your aim clear. Like the bolts on this card, energy moves best in straight lines, so cut the detours and go direct.
ctx.future: A rush of movement is coming. Expect news, invitations, travel or rapid progress. The outcome is a breakthrough that arrives suddenly, so be ready to act on it. The rainbow on this card hints that clarity and good news come with the speed.
ctx.challenge: The challenge is haste: scattering energy, speaking before thinking or rushing into decisions. Swiftness without direction becomes noise. Slow down just enough to aim before you release the arrow. Check your facts, read the message twice and think about where your words will land before you hit send.
ctx.advice: Act quickly and communicate clearly. Send the email, make the call, book the ticket. Momentum is on your side, so ride it rather than overthinking. Speed is a gift now; use it to clear obstacles and send your energy straight toward your goal before the window closes.
ctx.self: Your mind is racing with ideas and possibilities. You feel energised and quick. Channel that brilliance into a few clear actions so it does not burn off into restlessness. Your sharp mind is a powerful tool when you give it focus and a clear target instead of letting it race.
ctx.others: Others see you as quick-witted, busy and full of energy. Your environment is buzzing with communication. Messages from others may arrive suddenly and change your plans. Be ready to respond quickly and clearly, and keep your own messages short, honest and kind.
ctx.hopes: You hope things will finally move and that answers will come soon. You may fear being swept along too fast to keep up. Trust your ability to adapt in mid-flight. The current is strong, and you are a better swimmer than you think.
ctx.love: In love, things progress quickly: a sudden attraction, a flurry of messages, or plans moving forward faster than expected. Long-distance connections are favoured. Communicate openly and keep up with the pace together. Let the flow of words carry real feeling rather than mere chatter.
ctx.work: At work, deadlines, communications and opportunities arrive at speed. Projects can advance rapidly. Be efficient, answer promptly and use the momentum to clear backlogs. Clear communication and quick decisions will set you apart. Travel or new contacts may bring sudden openings worth pursuing.
ctx.spirit: Spirit sends its messages through flashes of insight and synchronicity. Pay attention to sudden knowing. The divine moves like light, and you are being invited to keep pace. Jot down the dreams, hunches and coincidences that arrive now; they are threads of light meant to guide you.
ctx.release: Release delays you have been creating out of fear. Let go of over-planning. Some things are meant to happen quickly, and your resistance only slows the current. Release too any old, slow habits of second-guessing, and trust that you can course-correct as you go rather than waiting for certainty.
ctx.shadow: Hidden may be a habit of staying busy to avoid feeling. Or your mind may be racing past what your heart is trying to say. Notice what you are rushing away from. Pause once a day to breathe, and let your heart catch up with your racing mind before the next decision.
ctx.foundation: At the root is a burst of energy and communication. The situation was set in motion by a message, an idea or a sudden decision, and it still carries that velocity. Follow that thread back to its source to understand what is moving through your life now and why it feels so urgent.
ctx.gift: Your gift is speed of mind and the ability to connect ideas and people quickly. Hidden help arrives as timely news, a lucky message or a flash of understanding. Your quickness lets you seize opportunities others miss, and your words can carry your fire across great distances.

name: Nine of Wands
title: Strength
imagery: Eight arrows cross in a pattern, pierced through the middle by one great central wand that bears the sun at its top and the moon at its base. Ten flames dance behind them. Sun and moon joined in one staff show conscious will and deep instinct united, and the arrows show that strength comes through constant change.
meaning: Strength is the Moon in Sagittarius, and Crowley called it the force that is stable precisely because it is always changing, as the moon changes yet endures. This is not the brittle strength of resistance but the deep vitality of someone who adapts, recovers and keeps going. Sun and moon, will and instinct, work together through you. Defence and attack, rest and action, flow into one another. This card says you have the reserves you need. Trust your resilience, keep moving like an arrow in flight, and you will find your strength renewing itself as you use it.
numerology: Nine is Yesod, the Foundation, sphere of the Moon; in Fire it is energy made stable through constant renewal.
affirmation: My strength renews itself as I change and grow.

ctx.past: You came through a long trial and discovered your staying power. Past challenges built a deep, flexible strength. That endurance is still in your bones. Every storm you weathered taught your roots to go deeper. You are not the same person who first faced that test.
ctx.present: You are stronger than you think. The heart of the matter is resilience: the ability to adapt, recover and carry on. Draw on your reserves, and trust both your instincts and your will. Like the moon, you can change shape and still be wholly yourself.
ctx.future: A period of renewed vitality and stability is coming. Expect to feel more grounded and capable, with energy returning after effort. You will be well able to handle what arrives. Health of spirit and steadiness of purpose will grow together, so keep doing the small things that restore you.
ctx.challenge: The challenge may be weariness or a defensive stance that has hardened. Strength turned rigid becomes brittle. Let yourself flex, rest and change rather than simply bracing. The arrows on this card fly; they do not stand still, and your strength depends on that same movement.
ctx.advice: Keep going, but keep moving. Combine action with rest and listen to your body’s signals. Use both reason and intuition, the sun and moon of this card, to guide your next step. Small, consistent acts of care will keep your reserves full for whatever lies ahead.
ctx.self: You feel tested but steady. There is a well of vitality in you that keeps refilling. Trust it, and honour your need for recovery as part of your strength. Your resilience is a quiet power, and it does not need to be proven to anyone.
ctx.others: Others see you as dependable and tough, someone who does not crumble. Your environment may lean on you. Make sure strength does not mean carrying everyone else alone. Ask for support when you need it; even the strongest wand needs others around it to form the pattern.
ctx.hopes: You hope to feel strong and secure again. You may fear running out of energy or being caught off guard. This card reassures you that your reserves are deeper than your fears. Your strength has carried you this far, and it will carry you further.
ctx.love: In love, this is a bond that has weathered storms and grown more resilient. Both partners can adapt and support one another. Let your guard down where it is safe to do so. Your shared history is a source of strength.
ctx.work: At work, persistence pays off. You can sustain effort over the long haul and recover quickly from setbacks. Pace yourself and adapt your strategy as conditions change. Your steadiness is an asset that others will come to rely on, and long projects are particularly well starred.
ctx.spirit: Spirit reminds you that true strength is fluid, like the moon that waxes and wanes yet never fails. The message is to trust the cycles of your energy as sacred. Rest when you need to rest, rise when you need to rise. Your soul knows its own rhythm.
ctx.release: Release the belief that strength means never changing your mind or never resting. Let go of defensive habits that no longer protect you. Let go of the idea that you must be strong every minute of every day. The moon rests in darkness before she grows full again.
ctx.shadow: Hidden may be exhaustion disguised as toughness, or a fear that showing need is weakness. Check where your resilience is masking a wound that needs care. Allow yourself to be cared for as you care for others.
ctx.foundation: At the root is a deep vitality, a capacity to endure and renew. The situation rests on your resilience, and it is a reliable base. Whatever comes, you have a deep well to draw from, so do not underestimate how much you can handle.
ctx.gift: Your gift is endurance with flexibility. You recover, adapt and carry on with grace. Hidden help comes through your own instincts, dreams and the steady return of energy. That steady inner fire has seen you through before and will again, as long as you keep feeding it.

name: Ten of Wands
title: Oppression
imagery: Two great Tibetan dorjes cross behind eight long bars that stand side by side like the grille of a cage, with harsh flames flaring behind. The fire is no longer free but locked into a rigid pattern. It shows energy turned against itself, power that has become a prison.
